verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships its own background automation: ongoing customer monitoring configurable per customer via API, plus marketed Customer Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. Asynchronous/batch screening and WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks let these run unattended. However, the agent evidence is thin marketing copy, and Starter-plan agent configuration cannot be customized, so users can enable the vendor's automations rather than define their own. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation builder (custom triggers, actions, schedules), in-depth docs on configuring agent behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
